intent_berth: none, because a bug enters at the TICKET door, not through /intent — /intent's own text refuses it: 'Do not route a bug through here: if editing lines of code fixes it, it is a ticket.'
sorted_berth: none, because the TICKET entry point has no /sorted firing behind it; the completeness this ticket would have been checked for is discharged by the measurement below, which is on disk at cairn/devices/tester/validations/ and re-runnable.

watchme.trigger: at each persist_validation that lowers a seal to `open`, and on the corpus census the build gate already walks
watchme.enough: when 30 days pass with zero `unsealing_because` records in the corpus and the sealed:open ratio has not fallen — at that point the guard has met no legitimate downgrade and the escape route can be argued out
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier
watchme.nexus: the tester's own validations dir is the record; the probe reads it

owner: tester (cairn/devices/tester) owns proven-space and its write door; CC builds
